WITH site_esi AS (
    SELECT 
        s.zoneregistry,
        ROUND(AVG(
            100.0 
            - 2.5 * ABS(CAST((e.ambient_cond::jsonb)->>'Ambic_Temp' AS numeric) - 20)
            - POWER(ABS((CAST((e.ambient_cond::jsonb)->>'Hume_Pct' AS numeric) - 50) / 2.0), 1.5)
            - 600.0 / (CAST((e.ambient_cond::jsonb)->>'Illume_Lux' AS numeric) + 100)
        ), 2) as avg_suitability
    FROM sites s
    JOIN environment e ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
),
site_category AS (
    SELECT 
        avg_suitability,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_suitability > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_suitability >= 70 AND avg_suitability <= 85 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
            WHEN avg_suitability >= 50 AND avg_suitability < 70 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
            ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
        END as eccs_category
    FROM site_esi
)
SELECT 
    eccs_category,
    COUNT(*) as site_count
FROM site_category
GROUP BY eccs_category
ORDER BY site_count DESC;
